0022600230.text: The Charlotte Hornets (4-6, 1-2 on the road, 9th in the East, 2 games back in the Southeast) visit the Phoenix Suns (4-6, 4-3 at home, 11th in the West, 5 games back in the Pacific), and both teams enter on a one-game winning streak. Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder (out, hamstring strain), Grant Williams (out, hamstring), and Kon Knueppel (out, hamstring strain), and Brandon Miller (groin soreness) and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Hornets winning the most recent meeting 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
